Systems Software Group

Department of Computer Science, Musterstadt University (fictional)

About

We build and measure the software layer closest to the hardware: operating systems, language runtimes, and the tooling to observe them in production. The group is led by Prof. Dr. Berta Beispiel.

Research areas

  • Energy-aware scheduling for containerized and edge workloads
  • WebAssembly runtimes beyond the browser
  • eBPF-based observability and kernel instrumentation
  • Lightweight virtualization for microcontrollers

Selected publications

  • B. Beispiel, K. Kunstfigur: “Joule Scheduling: Energy Budgets as First-Class Scheduler Inputs” (2026)
  • M. Mustermann, B. Beispiel: “Wasm at the Edge: Cold Starts Without the Cold” (2025)
  • K. Kunstfigur, B. Beispiel: “Tracing the Untraceable: eBPF Probes for Real-Time Runtimes” (2025)
  • B. Beispiel: “Micro-VMs on Microcontrollers: How Small Is Too Small?” (2024)

Team

  • Prof. Dr. Berta Beispiel (head)
  • Dr. Karl Kunstfigur (postdoctoral researcher)
  • Max Mustermann, M.Sc. (doctoral researcher)
